steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Ahhhhhhh...

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Ahhh...

steps.speaker: Mary
steps.content: You said you would always protect me.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Yes, I did... I said that.

steps.speaker: Mary
steps.content: You said you would always make me delicious food.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Yes, I did... I said that.

steps.speaker: Mary
steps.content: You said we were going to run the restaurant here.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: That's right... That's right...

steps.speaker: Mary
steps.content: You... have failed again. Even here, you can't do it.

steps.speaker: Mary
steps.content: But... Thank you, Labyrinth.

steps.speaker: Mary
steps.content: Thank you... for protecting me... one last time...
The dark shadow fades away, and her words drift away in the air.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: It's all my fault. It's all my fault. I'm not powerful enough. I couldn't protect you...

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: I'm a useless robot. I'm a useless maid.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: I can't even do... this.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: No, you're really great.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: You are...
Labyrinth looks at the person in front of her and seems to be searching through her memories.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: You have protected your current master well.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: But, I...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: We need to move forward together.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: No, no! The Chief... He is in danger! I can't lose someone important again!
steps.female_content: No, no! The Chief... She is in danger! I can't lose someone important again!

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: It was hard enough to lose Mary! I don't want to lose the Chief!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The Chief is really tough. He must be waiting for us.
steps.female_content: The Chief is really tough. She must be waiting for us.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Trust your master one more time.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Can I...? Do I... still have a chance...?
Hecate holds the cat up and puts it in Labyrinth's arms.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: There will be a chance. Definitely.
The cat in the painting seems to agree with Hecate.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Phew, feels like I had a long and embarrassing dream.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: But, I don't think anyone remembers it.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: If possible, I don't want to remember it either...

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Hehe, it's the connection between excellent tools.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Warning. Do not tell other Sinners. And do not talk about it with the Chief.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I promise you.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: Brilliant. Brilliant.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: I didn't expect you to overcome your weakness so quickly. You're good.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: Mutations are coming from the Gate of Hell ahead. It will project the fear within you guys.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: Be careful not to become its captive if you want to move forward.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: Do you still want to move forward?

steps.speaker: Labyrinth & Hecate
steps.content: Yes, the Chief must be there.
